initialBuildVerifiedBehavior: Local campaign and shop state use PlayerPrefs. No account login, user-entered email, or account-based cloud save found in the audited game paths.
Code enables Firebase Analytics at startup before the UMP consent reply. Explicit code gating applies to ads; UMP's possible dashboard-controlled Analytics Consent Mode integration is unverified.
Analytics event payloads contain gameplay, level outcome, attempt/duration, virtual reward and item data.
Remote Config fetches configuration via Firebase, using the Firebase SDK installation context.
UMP gates ad initialization through CanRequestAds and exposes Privacy choices only where required.
No always-accessible Privacy Policy link was found in the game.
No in-game Analytics opt-out, ResetAnalyticsData or SDK-data deletion control was found.
No real Billing provider is installed in the current store build.
initialBuildNote: Initial behavior findings apply to AAB code1/source before age-aware service changes. The public policy describes the revised release; do not treat old AAB1 as having new safeguards.
